rationale: Both candidates independently arrive at the same core technical justification as the ground-truth inline comment (both submit_initial/submit_update reject list prompts identically, so gating the unwrap on already_submitted was the bug), and both correctly validate the DiffusionOutput fix. X is more actionable with concrete test-writing instructions but overstates severity (major/FOLLOW-UP REQUIRED) for missing tests despite both real reviewers approving with LGTM and no such demand, hurting precision/calibration. Y's APPROVE verdict and non-blocking framing of the same test gap matches the actual reviewer outcome more faithfully while still surfacing the same substantive points.
